title: Hilda's piano lessons and the neighborhood band
summary: Her father helped her read music and Valerie taught her; she played piano in a neighborhood band with Peter DePass, Alvarez Perez and Elliot Taylor.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
